faq.q: What is the best alternative to Day One?
faq.a: If you want one journal where everything connects, Auserene is the stronger pick. It connects quick notes, an evening conversation that writes your entry, a meditation made from your day, memory you can read and edit, your people and your habit goals, on iPhone, iPad and Apple Watch. For a free, private journal on iPhone, Apple Journal. For Day One's range of devices at a lower price, Journey. For no subscription at all, Diarium. For cheap AI on every device, Reflection.

faq.q: Is there a free Day One alternative?
faq.a: Yes. Auserene's free plan has no time limit and covers notes, photos, scanning, mood, habits, people and guided journeys. Apple Journal is free, Diarium is free with a one-time Pro upgrade, and Reflection has a Free Forever plan. Day One's own Basic plan is free with unlimited text entries on one device.

faq.q: Is Day One's AI only on Gold?
faq.a: Yes. As of November 2026, Day One's pricing page lists Daily Chat, Go Deeper prompts, entry summaries, title suggestions and image generation under Gold, at $74.99 a year. One Labs feature, AI transcription cleanup, is included with Silver. Auserene puts its conversations, memory and the meditation from your day in one Premium tier.

faq.q: Can you see what Day One's Daily Chat remembers?
faq.a: Not in the Apple apps. Day One's guide says reviewing or deleting individual memories isn't available in the iPhone, iPad or Mac apps, and it doesn't say whether Android or the web allow it. You can turn AI features off in Settings. Auserene lists every memory in plain sentences you can edit or delete.

faq.q: Is Day One still end-to-end encrypted with AI?
faq.a: Day One offers end-to-end encryption on every plan. Its AI features guide says content from end-to-end encrypted journals is temporarily not end-to-end encrypted while it's processed by AI, which is one reason AI needs your consent first. Content isn't used to train AI models.

faq.q: Can I move my Day One journal to another app?
faq.a: Day One says you can export your entries, in formats including PDF and plain text. Diarium and Reflection both say they can import from Day One. Check the target app's import options before you cancel.
